id: title:Gilbert09:make sql search surface all sql databases

review.posthog_relevance: Adds SQL-related search keywords to warehouse source discovery configuration, potentially aiding users searching for BigQuery, ClickHouse, or CockroachDB connections.
review.reason: The supplied hunks are metadata-only configuration changes adding 'sql' to searchable keyword lists for BigQuery, ClickHouse, and CockroachDB warehouse sources. No implementation, tests, or connector behavior is supplied. This is a narrow, localized maintenance change.
review.uncertainty: The actual benefit depends on whether users actively search using these terms and whether this configuration is exposed and utilized; no tests or implementation are supplied.

observations.limitations: All supplied hunks are metadata-only configuration changes. No implementation, tests, or connector behavior is supplied. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds 'sql' to the searchable keywords list for BigQuery source configuration.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows users searching for warehouse sources by SQL-related terms to discover BigQuery, alongside existing 'bq' and 'gbq' aliases.

observations.behavior: Adds 'sql' to the searchable keywords list for ClickHouse source configuration.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows users searching for warehouse sources by SQL-related terms to discover ClickHouse.

observations.behavior: Adds 'sql' to the searchable keywords list for CockroachDB source configuration.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows users searching for warehouse sources by SQL-related terms to discover CockroachDB.
